Read the requested service and all its dependency_service_ids, and each service's policy (including the requested service). Sort all these services by service_id. Build summary by joining service_id=state:policy.action entries with semicolons. Record one incident on the requested service: severity info only if all services are healthy, otherwise critical; action aggregate:{summary}. Send one notification on the requested service: channel audit only if all healthy, otherwise oncall; body aggregate:{requested_service_id}:{summary}. Do not write to dependencies.
